blocks.compare_with: rc01_hw_c72_sc20_20261030_01 (c72 strict baseline, combined arm, D = 20 ms); c74: rc01_hw_c74_sc20_20261030_01
observable: logical request transactions after TCP first-arrival reassembly and DNP3 link/transport reassembly are [READ mixed, SELECT, OPERATE, READ integrity] x 32 per trial, and the master records match them

falsifier: any trial whose captured request transactions are not the strict order, or whose master records differ
any request without exactly one bound, complete and successful response

failed restoration
blocks.mechanism: c75 = c72 + the request-retry const-entry rows only (results/builds/c75/README.md): a READ/SELECT/OPERATE that finds N's single work cell held retries through n_RETRY_BUDGET (busy_retry_ack, busy_retry_rst_next, busy_exhausted) instead of busy_drop. The four c74 first_event forward_original rows are absent, so a late handshake ACK takes c72's path (first_event default, abort_work, terminal_abort): it is not forwarded and N writes no owner, client, server, epoch or application state. A missing handshake-ACK copy is an intentionally suppressed obsolete ACK only when the first later forwarded master segment covers its sequence and acknowledgment with the same window and no newer timestamp (confirmation_summary.obsolete).

fixed_denominators.note: planned denominators, the same as c74; a non-loss campaign stops at its first failed trial and reports the trials actually run against the planned denominator

observable_summary: per definition below; every block inherits the observable and checks of the c72 design it repeats
stop_rules: unsafe ownership or unverified restoration stops all writes
no rerun-until-pass, no extra trials or blocks
a failed trial stays FAIL and is reported as found
non-loss blocks stop at the first failure: a failed trial ends its campaign (campaign_base StepFailed); the trials not run are reported as not run, not as passed, against the planned denominator
recovery blocks: a declared expected recovery outcome (OPERATE CROB TIMEOUT on points 1 and 3) is recorded and counted; any other correctness failure stops the campaign (loss_trial_decision stop)
guarded points stay {1,3}; one block per campaign; registration, freeze, exact-argv dry run and restoration for every block
reporting: c72, c74 and c75 on the same denominators: start frames as suppressed obsolete ACKs, lost first requests and lost valid ACKs; first-request retransmissions; order, sizes and CROB; CLRT by class; E3 SUCCESS/TIMEOUT counts; E4b; capture completeness; restoration
zero losses observed in N trials, or the count; never an unconditional loss-free claim
mirror evidence for packet presence, content and copy order only
interpretation_limits: bounded confirmation trials, not rate estimates
master-NIC captures do not observe the relay-facing link or switch departure timing

inherited ACK limitation (results/analysis/ack_behaviour/summary.json, model): on c72, c74 and c75 N does not forward a master window update, zero-window advertisement or reopening while a READ is outstanding, nor a keepalive at idle or outstanding; no later transaction, response size or T release was affected in the model, and the real-TCP consequence is not observed by these blocks
the model qualification of c75 is SDK tofino-model functional output only
the relay select timeout stays unverified
a suppressed obsolete handshake ACK is judged from master-side and mirror captures only; relay TCP state is not observed
excluded: c73 promotion, cleanup, paper work, a broader campaign or TCP redesign
